title: HeartECG: a patient-disjoint benchmark of ECG-image models with zero-shot testing on real printouts
description: Code, Colab notebook and result files for the manuscript 'Heart-disease classification and myocardial-infarction detection from 12-lead ECG images: a patient-disjoint benchmark of classical, convolutional, transformer and fusion models with zero-shot testing on real printouts' (submitted to Biomedical Signal Processing and Control). PTB-XL signals are rendered as realistic 3x4 printout images with printout randomisation; classical ML pipelines, four pretrained deep backbones, a three-stream fusion network and a 1-D signal reference are compared under one patient-disjoint protocol and applied zero-shot to 928 real ECG printouts.
